Runtime Lifecycle v2: migrate Grok ACP to activity leases (#193)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-13
  description: |-
    ## Execution instruction
    
    Skip Planning. Migrate the production Grok ACP runner from the temporary fixed prompt deadline to lifecycle v2. Do not alter Cursor, Codex, generic persistence, or scheduler architecture.
    
    ## Dependencies
    
    Blocked by lifecycle v2 persistence and supervised dispatch worker Issues.
    
    ## Responsibility and file ownership
    
    Own:
    
    - crates/agent/grok session, prompt runtime, and provider-event normalization required for activity reporting;
    - codeon/crates/codeon/src/execution/agents/grok* production authority, retained-session state, inspection, cancel/recover, and tests;
    - removal of the temporary GROK_PROMPT_TIMEOUT only after all acceptance criteria in this Issue pass.
    
    ## Required behavior
    
    1. Split prompt acknowledgement timeout from execution activity lease.
    2. Waiting for first accepted prompt evidence uses ack_timeout only.
    3. After acceptance, Text, ToolStarted, ToolCompleted, provider terminal, cancelled, and provider error events are converted to AgentActivityEvidence with bounded digest and provider identity.
    4. Drain and persist nonterminal provider events during inspection; do not only detect terminal events.
    5. Delete synthetic observed_steps increments. Empty inspection and retained PromptRunning state do not renew.
    6. Idle expiry closes/cancels only this Grok session and produces recovery/attention according to the shared controller; it does not exit daemon.
    7. Resource ceiling requests checkpoint/cancel/exact resume rather than directly failing the business Operation.
    8. SentUnknown remains outcome-unknown and requires recovery; do not redispatch automatically.
    9. Continuation attempts inherit the same policy and cannot reset resource ceiling or manufacture activity.
    10. Late events from a closed generation are fenced and auditable.
    11. Session cleanup remains proven before completion context/capability release.
    
    ## Compatibility
    
    Existing v1 dispatches retain legacy interpretation. New v2 dispatches must not construct a fixed prompt_deadline. Do not change model selection, Grok credentials, completion authority, prompt contents, or business-result validation.
    
    ## Verification
    
    Add fake ACP tests for first-event ack, periodic text/tool activity beyond the old 30-minute limit using paused time, silent idle expiry, duplicate events, terminal, cancellation ambiguity, provider exit, continuation, late generation evidence, exact recovery, and concurrent operation isolation.
    
    Run Grok adapter and Codeon Grok runner tests. If live Grok credentials/runtime are available, perform a bounded real canary and record dispatch/session evidence without secrets.
    
    ## Definition of done
    
    Grok runs as long as trustworthy activity continues, silent hangs affect only their dispatch, no synthetic activity exists, and the four-hour timeout workaround is removed.
